# Synoikia core

One MCP server for many self-hosted services, with one sandbox, permission gate, approval flow and audit log.

Who and what talks to Synoikia.

### execute through the gate

One binding call from model code to the upstream and back.

```mermaid
---
title: "execute through the gate"
---
graph LR
  McpClient@{ shape: rectangle, label: "MCP client" }
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints@{ shape: rectangle, label: "MCP endpoints" }
  SynoikiaCoreAuth@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Auth" }
  SynoikiaCoreRuntime@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Runtime" }
  SynoikiaSandbox@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Sandbox" }
  SynoikiaCoreGate@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Gate" }
  SynoikiaCorePluginHost@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Plugin host" }
  SynoikiaCoreApprovals@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Approvals" }
  SynoikiaInstance@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Instance" }
  Upstream@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Upstream" }
  SynoikiaCoreAudit@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Audit log" }
  McpClient -. "`1. calls execute with code`" .-> SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints -. "`2. authenticates the client`" .-> SynoikiaCoreAuth
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints -. "`3. starts the execution`" .-> SynoikiaCoreRuntime
  SynoikiaCoreRuntime -. "`4. runs the code in a fresh isolate`" .-> SynoikiaSandbox
  SynoikiaSandbox -. "`5. calls a binding`" .-> SynoikiaCoreGate
  SynoikiaCoreGate -. "`6. resolves the operation and its 
targets`" .-> SynoikiaCorePluginHost
  SynoikiaCoreGate -. "`7. asks for a human approval when the 
access level is ask`" .-> SynoikiaCoreApprovals
  SynoikiaCoreGate -. "`8. invokes the operation`" .-> SynoikiaCorePluginHost
  SynoikiaCorePluginHost -. "`9. sends invoke`" .-> SynoikiaInstance
  SynoikiaInstance -. "`10. calls the upstream API`" .-> Upstream
  SynoikiaCoreGate -. "`11. records the decision and the 
redacted result`" .-> SynoikiaCoreAudit
  SynoikiaCoreGate -. "`12. returns the redacted result`" .-> SynoikiaSandbox
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints -. "`13. returns the tool result`" .-> McpClient
```

### Human approval

A call with access level ask waits until its user decides on the approval page.

```mermaid
---
title: "Human approval"
---
graph LR
  SynoikiaCoreGate@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Gate" }
  SynoikiaCoreApprovals@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Approvals" }
  SynoikiaDatabase@{ shape: disk, label: "Database" }
  McpClient@{ shape: rectangle, label: "MCP client" }
  User@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "User" }
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints@{ shape: rectangle, label: "MCP endpoints" }
  SynoikiaCoreAuth@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Auth" }
  SynoikiaCoreGate -. "`1. requests an approval`" .-> SynoikiaCoreApprovals
  SynoikiaCoreApprovals -. "`2. stores the pending approval with 
redacted parameters`" .-> SynoikiaDatabase
  SynoikiaCoreApprovals -. "`3. sends the approval page link`" .-> McpClient
  McpClient -. "`4. shows the link`" .-> User
  User -. "`5. opens the approval page`" .-> SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints -. "`6. signs the user in`" .-> SynoikiaCoreAuth
  User -. "`7. approves or denies`" .-> SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints -. "`8. records the decision`" .-> SynoikiaCoreApprovals
  SynoikiaCoreApprovals -. "`9. continues or denies the call`" .-> SynoikiaCoreGate
```

### OAuth sign-in of an MCP client

The built-in authorization server gives an MCP client a token for chosen endpoints.

```mermaid
---
title: "OAuth sign-in of an MCP client"
---
graph LR
  McpClient@{ shape: rectangle, label: "MCP client" }
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints@{ shape: rectangle, label: "MCP endpoints" }
  User@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "User" }
  SynoikiaCoreAuth@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Auth" }
  McpClient -. "`1. calls an endpoint without a token`" .-> SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints -. "`2. answers with the resource metadata 
link`" .-> McpClient
  McpClient -. "`3. opens the authorization page`" .-> User
  User -. "`4. signs in and consents to endpoints 
and a ceiling`" .-> SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints
  SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints -. "`5. stores the grant and a single-use 
code`" .-> SynoikiaCoreAuth
  McpClient -. "`6. exchanges the code and the PKCE 
verifier for tokens`" .-> SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints
  McpClient -. "`7. calls the endpoint with the access 
token`" .-> SynoikiaCoreMcpEndpoints
```
